title: Kentucky man says agent sold him his own home and pressured him for an extra $85,000
summary_full: After hiring estate agent Rick Walters to sell his home, Jason Wagner later bought a property from him. Wagner alleges he was coerced into paying an extra $85,000 above their original agreement. The Kentucky Court of Appeals reinstated many of Wagner's claims against Walters and Lenihan Real Estate, allowing him to proceed in a lower court after previous dismissals. The decision emphasized concerns regarding Walters' financial transactions during the sale.
